source.title: CYCA Sailing Program 2021-2022
source.notes: CYCA states that all published positions and distances are approximate. Coordinate locations are conversions of positions printed in the source. chartApproximateCoordinate values were digitised from the inside-back-cover CYCA Harbour & S.O.P.S. Marks map and are low-confidence because the chart expressly states NOT TO SCALE.
